title: One line of <releases root>/deploy-log.jsonl (A1)
description: Frozen in phase 001. Written by scripts/deploy.py (S19), one JSON object per line per step, appended, never rewritten. The log lives at the releases root, outside every release and every checkout. It is the only place a secret file's checksum is recorded: the release itself names no secret (k2gen.model.SECRET_FILES).

from.description: The release the pointers named before; null on the first deploy.

step.description: The deploy step, in kebab case (S19 names them).

outcome.description: How the step ended; a failed step after the swap is followed by a rollback record.

operator.description: Who ran the deploy, as the host user name.

reason.description: Optional, on a failed step: why it failed, as deploy printed it, at most 2000 characters; never a secret (added by step S19b, additively).

secrets.description: Each secret file the release's services mount, as deploy found it at the step: its path under ${K2_SECRETS} to the sha256 of its bytes. Never the content. A missing file is absent from the map.
